name: mc1_sl_teleports
description: Multicore stage 1, teleports only (SL allows at most 6 teleports a minute, so 30 s pauses). The owner logs in at home (-StartRegion), teleports to the busy region (-BusyRegion) when the pop-up asks; the plugin then runs five teleports within it and five between it and the home region in one continuous Tracy capture (MC1-teleports), and a final pop-up. No still/moving captures, no fps probe.

owner_teleport.ready_message: Ready for the busy region: teleport there now.
